name: smwmusic-donkey-kong-gb-nothing-stands-in-your-way-showdown-at-the-tower-remix
title: Donkey Kong (GB) - Nothing Stands in Your Way! ~ Showdown at the Tower (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Showdown at the Tower from Donkey Kong '94. Played through the game a couple months back and thought it'd be a lotta fun doing a remix of... THIS FANTASTIC FINAL BOSS THEME, HOLY HOT FREAKING DAMN!!! IT'S CATCHY, INTENSE, AND GOES OFF HARDER THAN IT NEEDED TOO!!! Tell me a single Game Boy theme that has a freaking guitar solo. A GUITAR SOLO ON THE GAME BOY SOUNDCHIP!!!

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. F# Minor w/ slight detune (Original Pitch, turned on default)
1. F# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. E Minor (Custom Pitch)
